title: Remove all authentication logic and make application fully public

requirements.summary: Remove all Internet Identity authentication logic from the frontend including SignInScreen, SignInRequiredDialog, and all authentication-related components
acceptanceCriteria: SignInScreen component is removed or disabled
SignInRequiredDialog component is removed or disabled
No authentication prompts appear when accessing the application
Application loads directly to the dashboard without login

file_operations.description: Disable SignInScreen by making it render null or an empty fragment so it never displays, preventing any login prompts from appearing
Disable SignInRequiredDialog by making it render null or return early without displaying any authentication prompts

requirements.summary: Remove AuthApprovalGate component or modify it to always render children without checking authentication or approval status
acceptanceCriteria: AuthApprovalGate no longer blocks access based on authentication
Application renders main content immediately without authentication checks
No approval screens or gates are shown to users

file_operations.description: Modify AuthApprovalGate to unconditionally render its children prop without performing any authentication, approval, or actor readiness checks, effectively bypassing all access control
Remove or comment out the AuthApprovalGate wrapper from the router tree so the application renders directly without any authentication gating

requirements.summary: Replace all authentication state checks with default authenticated state throughout the application
acceptanceCriteria: useInternetIdentity hook is no longer used in components
All isAuthenticated checks are removed or hardcoded to true
No authentication-related context providers wrap the application

file_operations.description: Remove InternetIdentityProvider wrapper from the React root so no authentication context is provided to the application
Remove any useInternetIdentity hook calls and authentication state checks; simplify login/logout UI elements or remove them entirely

requirements.summary: Remove admin role checks, staff restrictions, and approval status checks from all components and hooks including useStaffRestrictions, useAppMode, and useApprovalStatus
acceptanceCriteria: All users can access bulk upload functionality
All users can perform delete operations
Admin-only routes and features are accessible to everyone
Access Management page is removed or accessible to all

file_operations.description: Modify useStaffRestrictions to always return { canDelete: true, canBulkUpload: true } without checking admin status or app mode, enabling all users to perform restricted operations
Modify useApprovalStatus to always return isApproved: true and isAdmin: true without querying the backend, removing all approval and admin checks
Remove useStaffRestrictions check and related error messages so all users can access bulk challan upload functionality
Remove useStaffRestrictions check and related error messages so all users can access bulk inventory upload functionality
Remove useStaffRestrictions check and related error messages so all users can access bulk payment upload functionality
Remove useStaffRestrictions check and related error messages so all users can access bulk petty cash upload functionality
Remove useStaffRestrictions check and related error messages so all users can access bulk client upload functionality
Remove useStaffRestrictions check and related error messages so all users can access new format challan bulk upload functionality
Remove useStaffRestrictions check and related error messages so all users can access challan date restoration functionality
Remove useStaffRestrictions check that controls delete operation visibility; enable delete functionality for all users
Remove useMutationGate and SignInRequiredDialog dependencies; remove useStaffRestrictions check that controls delete operations; enable all inventory operations for all users
Remove admin-only access checks and make the page accessible to all users, or remove the page entirely if no longer needed without authentication
Remove admin mode badges, conditional Access Management link visibility, and any admin/staff role indicators from the layout

requirements.summary: Remove useMutationGate hook or modify it to always return mutations as ready without checking authentication state
acceptanceCriteria: All mutations are immediately available without authentication checks
useMutationGate no longer blocks mutations based on auth state
Components can perform mutations without authentication

file_operations.description: Modify useMutationGate to always return { mutationsReady: true, blockingReason: null } without checking actor state or authentication, allowing all mutations to proceed immediately

requirements.summary: Modify useActor hook to create backend actor instances without requiring Internet Identity authentication or admin token parameters
acceptanceCriteria: useActor hook creates actor without identity parameter
Admin token URL parameter is no longer used
Backend actor connects using anonymous identity or no authentication

file_operations.description: Modify useActorWithConnection to create backend actor with anonymous identity without requiring Internet Identity authentication; remove identity and admin token parameter dependencies

requirements.summary: Remove ApprovalRequiredScreen component and all approval request functionality from the frontend
acceptanceCriteria: ApprovalRequiredScreen is removed or never rendered
No approval request functionality exists
Users never see approval pending messages

file_operations.description: Disable ApprovalRequiredScreen by making it render null or an empty fragment so it never displays approval request UI

requirements.summary: Remove useBootstrapAdmin hook and all admin bootstrapping logic from the frontend
acceptanceCriteria: useBootstrapAdmin hook is removed or unused
No admin bootstrapping occurs on admin domains
Admin token handling is removed

file_operations.description: Modify useBootstrapAdmin to return a no-op mutation that does nothing; disable all admin bootstrapping logic
Remove useBootstrapAdmin hook call and admin bootstrapping logic from AuthApprovalGate to prevent admin initialization attempts
